title: What does a writing orientation change?
predecessor_scope: Supplied critical reading prefers the reference to patient and inquiry. No canonical adoption or independent participant result follows.
changed_condition: Form of the complete Geiger passage: repetition, montage or recurrence. Explanations and documentary material may move within this encounter.
confounds: Length, paragraph rhythm and explanation timing vary together. This is an editorial comparison, not an isolated causal test of an author.
Repeated reading can itself change attention. Record the reading order; a second reader may use another order.

tests.artifact: What becomes noticeable, investigable or formally experienced here that the reference did not make available? Name a detail in the passage.
tests.map: After reading the complete chapter, does an earlier or later encounter acquire a different significance? Name that encounter and the relation, or record no change.
tests.decision_rule: Discard a candidate that supports neither test. A result on one test warrants a scoped revision; evidence on both makes a stronger candidate, not automatic adoption. Retain the reference when no gain justifies the cost.

candidates.label: Repetition
candidates.strategy_provenance: Beckett-associated operation from the existing toolbox; an original local experiment, not stylistic imitation.
candidates.formal_change: Three RESTART actions and four identical sound sentences precede the definition. The explanation is delayed rather than expanded.
candidates.artifact_test: Does repeated wording give a detectable duration to replay, or simply become tedious?
candidates.map_test: Does the later compulsory return recall these chosen restarts while remaining a different kind of return?
candidates.risk: The text may spend attention without making a new distinction; a reader may wrongly equate RESTART with the sphere's compulsory return.

candidates.label: Montage
candidates.strategy_provenance: Eliot-associated juxtaposition from the existing toolbox; no borrowed voice or invented participant testimony.
candidates.formal_change: The receipt precedes the first written click. Screen, action, implementation and other instruments occupy explicitly different registers.
candidates.artifact_test: Can the reader distinguish what the screen shows, what RESTART sounds like, and what comes from code or the receipt without a continuous explanation?
candidates.map_test: Does the return to the held RAND digits distinguish keeping an outcome from keeping a beginning, or repeat work the book already did?
candidates.risk: Labels can turn the passage into a catalogue, and another archival intervention may be redundant.

candidates.label: Recurrence
candidates.strategy_provenance: Joyce/Borges-associated recurrence and rule-following, as proposed in the supplied feedback; no new scholarly claim about either work.
candidates.formal_change: 435 moves through remembered hand movement, colour, capture, clicks and dated acquisition; the transition reverses number-to-movement into movement-to-number.
candidates.artifact_test: Does following 435 clarify the different procedures and the distinction between a saved source value and a generator input?
candidates.map_test: Does MOVE / KEEP now change the direction of a relation established at the opening sphere?
candidates.risk: Tracking the number may become another inventory or imply that private instrument streams are identical.
